name: University of Turin
summary: Large public university in Turin; three English bachelor's in business, economics with data science and global law, plus English-taught Medicine.

ib.text: A foreign school qualification assessed on Apply@UniTo. Degrees with restricted places select by entrance test; open-access degrees need a non-selective TOLC test.

programmes.name: Business & Management
programmes.about: An undergraduate business and management degree taught in English by Turin's Department of Management.
programmes.overview: You cover the main functional areas of business, accounting and finance, marketing, strategy, economics and organisational behaviour, together with the economic, social, political and legal environment in which firms decide. Courses run on a block system: you focus on one subject for two to six weeks and take the exam straight after, which lets international and visiting faculty and business professionals teach. Cohorts are small, with case studies, seminars, workshops, group presentations and business games. After three years you can add a fourth year in the US at Kent State or Southern Illinois University Edwardsville for an American BSc. Internship and Erasmus options are available.
programmes.ib: Restricted places, selected by entrance test; the rules are in the programme's call.
programmes.selectionNote: Local restricted number of places, filled by an entrance test ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Economics and Finance with Data Science
programmes.about: Economics and finance combined with data science, taught in English by the Department of Economics, Social Studies, Applied Mathematics and Statistics.
programmes.overview: Economics and finance are combined with data science and its applications. The first two years give foundations in economics, and in the third year you specialise in economics, finance or statistics. Alongside lectures there are lab activities such as data analysis labs, and the final thesis may be based on research in a company or research institution. The degree works with the Collegio Carlo Alberto, the UNITA university network and universities in Europe and beyond. Graduates work as economists, policy experts and analysts in banking, insurance, consultancy, government agencies and international companies, or continue to master's degrees in economics, finance, statistics, actuarial science or management.
programmes.ib: Limited places for 2026-27, selected by entrance test; the rules are in the programme's call.
programmes.selectionNote: Limited number of places, filled by an entrance test ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Global Law and Transnational Legal Studies
programmes.about: Global and transnational law taught in English by Turin's Department of Law.
programmes.overview: The first year gives basic knowledge of the main legal fields from a global viewpoint. In the second year you deepen European and global law through comparison and study the main European and international institutions, and the third year looks at legal practice and decision-making in European and international courts, with electives to specialise. Teaching combines presentations, tutorials, seminars, simulations of legal process and traineeships, and you are encouraged to train abroad through Erasmus+, traineeships and scholarships. Graduates work in the legal divisions of multinational organisations, in institutions and in NGOs and the third sector.
programmes.ib: Admission rules are in the programme's call; check whether it has restricted places or a TOLC entry test.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission by the programme's call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery (MedInTO)
programmes.about: Turin's six-year medical degree taught in English (MedInTO), run by the Department of Clinical and Biological Sciences.
programmes.overview: The six-year programme is built around courses for each year plus elective learning activities, with a degree thesis at the end. Clinical training in clerkships is central, supported by a centre for advanced medical simulation and an e-learning platform, and typical early subjects include anatomy, physiology and biochemistry. Graduates are prepared to practise in national and international settings, to start specialist training in any branch of medicine and surgery, and to apply evidence-based medicine ethically. A MD-PhD programme opens from the second year for qualified students, and Erasmus and international mobility, including research placements abroad, are available.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English; in 2026 it was held on 29 September.
programmes.selectionNote: Places set nationally and filled by the admission test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The 2027-28 calls are not out yet. In 2026 the first call for bachelor's ran 19 February–15 April, with a later EU-only call for restricted-place degrees from 1 July to 14 September.
There is one intake a year and the academic year starts in October.
Several of Turin's other English offers are master's degrees or English curricula inside Italian-taught degrees.
